name: Labelled icon
purpose: Shows a short fact with an icon that says what kind of fact it is, such as a vehicle's year with a calendar, its fuel with a pump, or its colour with a palette.

origin.notes: The app's VehicleSpecView draws a vehicle's year, fuel and colour this way: an SF Symbol in Title 1 over its label in Body, or, when they don't fit side by side, in Title 3 beside it. The app gives each its own accessibilityLabel, such as the year's, which label stands in for here.

icon.description: The name of a Material Symbol, such as calendar_month, local_gas_station or palette.

layout.description: stacked: the icon over its label, both centred, as the app shows them side by side. inline: the icon before its label, as the app shows them when they don't fit side by side.

label.description: What screen readers hear in place of the label alone, when the label doesn't say what it's about, such as Year of manufacture: 2021.

inputs.content: The fact, a word or two, such as 2021, Petrol or Yellow.

rules: Keep the label to a word or two: stacked, it stays on one line.
Pick an icon that says what kind of fact it is, not what it is: a calendar for a year, whatever the year.
Give it a label for screen readers when the fact alone doesn't say what it's about, as 2021 doesn't.
Put a few side by side in summary columns, as the app does a vehicle's year, fuel and colour.

avoid.when: For something with a deadline or a validity, such as a vehicle's tax
For a number that matters on its own, such as penalty points
For a fact that needs more than a word or two

other.title: Material Symbols, the icons it draws

references.description: A vehicle's year, fuel and colour, stacked, on its detail screen, in light mode

examples.name: A vehicle's year, fuel and colour, in summary columns
examples.html:
<govuk-app-summary-columns>
  <govuk-app-summary-column>
    <govuk-app-labelled-icon icon="calendar_month" label="Year of manufacture: 2021">2021</govuk-app-labelled-icon>
  </govuk-app-summary-column>
  <govuk-app-summary-column>
    <govuk-app-labelled-icon icon="local_gas_station" label="Fuel: Petrol">Petrol</govuk-app-labelled-icon>
  </govuk-app-summary-column>
  <govuk-app-summary-column>
    <govuk-app-labelled-icon icon="palette" label="Colour: Yellow">Yellow</govuk-app-labelled-icon>
  </govuk-app-summary-column>
</govuk-app-summary-columns>
